prompt: Write a three paragraph biography for Australian Film Producer Drew Bailey, list his oscar nominated film and his time as an assistant director.
response: Drew Bailey is an Australian film producer known for his work on critically acclaimed films. He began his career as an assistant director on various independent productions before transitioning to producing. Bailey's production company has been behind several award-winning films, including "The Great Australian Dream Machine," for which he received an Academy Award nomination.
